endorsements.name: Chris & Benedict Schlueter
endorsements.label: Your TEE Is Only as Strong as Its Interconnect: Breaking SEV-SNP using AMD's Infinity Fabric
endorsements.description: Modern CPUs are comprised of many different components and therefore require a high amount of interconnectivity between each other. This task is handled by internal routing networks. These networks are hugely important for the CPU to function correctly and in a performant fashion. Unfortunately for researchers, they are also not documented in depth, which makes investigating their impacts on the security of different CPU features difficult. Read more
